intro: CSIR-National Physical Laboratory (NPL), New Delhi has announced 25 Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) posts under Advertisement No. Rectt./05/2026. The minimum qualification is 10th (Matriculation) pass, making it a great central government job for matriculates.
The posts are in Pay Level-1 (basic ₹18,000). Applications are offline and must reach NPL by 23 December 2026. This recruitment also appeared in Employment News (28 Nov – 4 Dec 2026).

p: Upper age limit and relaxation for reserved categories are given in the official advertisement on nplindia.in.

table: Exemption as per notice – see official notification

ul: Trade test / written examination as per CSIR rules

ol: Fill it neatly and attach self-attested documents and fee proof.
Send it by post to the address in the notice so that it reaches by 23 December 2026.
